Class ContainerTabs.Groups<G,K>

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.api.panel.ContainerTabs.Groups<G,K>
Enclosing class:
ContainerTabs
public static final class ContainerTabs.Groups<G,K> extends Object
Builds a list of groups (ContainerTabs.groups(String, ModeScope, Supplier, Function)). Its screens, order, edge and sub-tab size are the list's, shared by every group in it; each group's header and each key's tab set the rest. Each group is a keyed list with a header, as one declared alone is, and behaves as one: its header, its sub-tabs sliding out and back, paging and pinning.

  • Method Details

    • header

      public ContainerTabs.Groups<G,K> header(BiConsumer<? super G, ContainerTabs.Builder> build)
      Required: each group's header tab, set up as ContainerTabs.Keyed.header sets one up, by group. Run once per group, the frame its key first appears. Its id is id#group.

    • tab

      public ContainerTabs.Groups<G,K> tab(ContainerTabs.GroupTab<? super G, ? super K> build)
      Required: each key's sub-tab in a group, set up as ContainerTabs.Keyed.tab sets one up, by group and key. Run once per key in a group, the frame it first appears there. Its id is id#group#key.

    • expandedWhen

      public ContainerTabs.Groups<G,K> expandedWhen(Predicate<? super G> condition)
      When a group's sub-tabs are out, by group, read every frame, as ContainerTabs.Keyed.expandedWhen(BooleanSupplier) reads. Default: always.

    • tabSize

      public ContainerTabs.Groups<G,K> tabSize(int width, int height)
      Every sub-tab's size, as ContainerTabs.Keyed.tabSize(int, int) takes it. Default 18 by 17.

    • order

      public ContainerTabs.Groups<G,K> order(int order)
      Where the groups go in their row, every tab of them together, in the group keys' order: lower is further left; ties go by id. Default 0.

    • edge

      public ContainerTabs.Groups<G,K> edge(ContainerTabs.Edge edge)
      The edge their row stands on. Default ContainerTabs.Edge.CONTAINERS_TOP.
